[NFCT.1.4.2] A loaded schema's slots, as its declaration states them, are the
enforced slot-type contract ([NFCT.1.1]). The introspection accessors
(`ds_schema_get_name` / `_get_slot_count` / `_get_slot` / `_get_lifecycle` /
`_get_ttl_ns`) read the contract back, each slot as a `ds_slot_desc_t`
([NFCT.1.4.1]). A schema's name, in `ds_engine_schema_find` and
`ds_schema_get_name` and every binding's lookup, is its own name ([LIMP.13.1]):
`plant.sensors.Reading`, for a schema of that library, and never an alias.
